# MyGo native UI

Based on `github.com/egoist/mygo/ui` at v0.2.16, under the included MIT license.

Yeek extends the native text editor here so syntax colors, line numbers, selection commands, completion popups, and scrolling use the same layout, input-method, and accessibility state as text editing. Code editors can also operate as single-line fields with normal submit and Tab behavior. The framework and CLI remain pinned to MyGo v0.2.16.

`SplitQuiet` is a split whose divider is drawn only while it is hovered or dragged, as in Yaak's pane layout.

A `NumberInput` given a width widens its text field to fill it, so it lines up with other controls of that width.
